attributes.name: Mandragora
attributes.powers:
The Mandragora is immune to the Mental and Poison traits. If the check to defeat has the Electricity trait, the difficulty is increased by 3.

If undefeated, a random character at your location is dealt Combat damage equal to the number of cards that have the Attack trait and weapon in your hand.
